name: gps-pmr-mobile
description: GPS PMR — application mobile (iOS / Android) basée sur Capacitor

scripts.android:init: npm run web && npx cap add android && node scripts/patch-native.mjs android && npx cap sync android
scripts.ios:init: npm run web && npx cap add ios && node scripts/patch-native.mjs ios && npx cap sync ios
scripts.sync: npm run web && npx cap sync
